mapper.select: SELECT rowid RIDR_ROWID, DUPLICATE_STATUS, STATE_CD , STATENO, COMMENTS FROM RAW_ACRF_RIDR_INFO WHERE ACRF_DOC_ID=#{rawAcrfDocId}

SELECT CD4_SRC_ID , DOCUMENT_ID , CD4_COUNT , CD4_PERCENT , CLOSEST_TO_CURRENT_DX , FIRST_LOW_CD4 , COLLECTION_DATE , FACILITY_NAME , FACILITY_EHARS_UID , CLIA , LAB_NAME , PROV_NAME, PROV_FNAME, PROV_LNAME, PROV_MNAME, PROV_SUFFIX , MANUFACTURER FROM ${tableName} WHERE DOCUMENT_ID=#{documentId} order by CLOSEST_TO_CURRENT_DX asc

SELECT lab.LAB_SRC_ID , lab.DOCUMENT_ID , lab.RAPID_TEST , lab.COPIES_ML , lab.LOG , lab.COLLECTION_DATE , lab.${testCodeColumn} ACRF_TEST_CODE , lab.PARENT_TEST_TYPE , lab.${resultCodeColumn} ACRF_RESULT_CODE , lab.OTHER_TEST , lab.MANUFACTURER , lab.FACILITY_NAME , lab.FACILITY_EHARS_UID , lab.LAB_NAME , CLIA , lab.PROV_NAME, lab.PROV_FNAME, lab.PROV_LNAME, lab.PROV_MNAME, lab.PROV_SUFFIX , lab.INDEX_VALUE , lab.HIV1_CML_ANALYTE_RESULT , lab.HIV1_LOG_ANALYTE_RESULT , lab.HIV12_AB_ANALYTE_RESULT , lab.HIV1_AB_ANALYTE_RESULT , lab.HIV1_AB_ANALYTE_RESULT_INDEX , lab.HIV2_AB_ANALYTE_RESULT , lab.HIV2_AB_ANALYTE_RESULT_INDEX , lab.HIV1_AG_ANALYTE_RESULT , lab.HIV1_AG_ANALYTE_RESULT_INDEX , lab.DIAGNOSTIC_ALGORITHM_STEP , lab.RAPID_TEST_TYPE , lab.INTERPRETATION , lab.ANALYTE_INTERPRETATION , acrf_test.TEST_SECTION
FROM ${tableName} lab, CODED_ACRF_TEST acrf_test WHERE DOCUMENT_ID =#{documentId}
and lab.parent_test_type = acrf_test.parent_test_type_code
and lab.PCRF_TEST_CODE = acrf_test.ACRF_TEST_CODE
and lab.ACRF_TEST_CODE = acrf_test.ACRF_TEST_CODE
order by LAB_SRC_ID
mapper.update: update ${tableName} set ${CRF_COLUMN_ID} = #{codedArvMedicationsVO.documentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ARV_USE_TYPE = #{codedArvMedicationsVO.arvUseType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ARV_MEDICATION = #{codedArvMedicationsVO.arvMedications,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , ARV_BEGIN_DATE = #{codedArvMedicationsVO.arvMedicationsDateBegan,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , ARV_END_DATE = #{codedArvMedicationsVO.arvMedicationsDateOfLastUse,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ARV_OTHER_USE_TYPE = #{codedArvMedicationsVO.otherArvUseType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where rowid = #{codedArvMedicationsVO.arvSrcId}

update RAW_ACRF_RIDR_INFO set ACRF_DOC_ID = #{documentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DUPLICATE_STATUS = #{DUPLICATE_STATUS,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STATE_CD = #{STATE_CD,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , STATENO = #{STATENO,jdbcType=VARCHAR} , COMMENTS = #{COMMENTS,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where rowid = #{RIDR_ROWID}
mapper.select: select ACRF_TEST_CODE, PARENT_TEST_TYPE_CODE, ACRF_TEST_DESC, TEST_SECTION from CODED_ACRF_TEST where END_DATE is NULL or END_DATE > SYSDATE order by SORT_ORDER
mapper.update: UPDATE SURVEILLANCE_ASSIGNMENT set ${crfDocColumnName} = #{crfDocumentId}, LAST_UPDATED_BY = #{lastUpdatedBy}, LAST_UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE where DOCUMENT_ID = #{documentId}
mapper.select: select DISTINCT(EHARS_FAC_UID) from SUB_FACILITY where SUB_FACILITY_ID > 0 and EHARS_FAC_UID is not null
select DOCUMENT_SOURCE_CODE, DOCUMENT_SOURCE_DESCRIPTION from CODED_DOCUMENT_SOURCE order by DOCUMENT_SOURCE_DESCRIPTION
select OTHER_ID_TYPE, OTHER_ID_TYPE_DESC from CODED_ACRF_OTHER_ID_TYPE order by SORT_ORDER
select LOOKUP_CD, LOOKUP_NAME from CODED_ACRF_REF_DATA where REF_COLUMN = #{referenceColumn} order by LOOKUP_NAME
SELECT CLIA, LAB_NAME FROM lab_physical_facility WHERE flag_active = 'Y' and CLIA != '-9999' order by lab_name
